D.  NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

E.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, announced that the Public Safety Center is collaborating with
Cerritos College for them to use the Public Safety Center Computer Lab for a Spanish­speaking
computer class; that September 16, 2025, will be the first Southeast Collaborative meeting; and that a
Trunk­or­Treat event will be held on October 24, 2025.

Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, reported about a letter received from our local casino to extend our
Operating and Covenant Performance Incentive Agreement, that was established on February 22, 2011;
and requested that the Mayor establish an Ad Hoc Committee to work with staff on the involvement
process, next steps, data assessment, and possible recommendations to the council.

Mayor De Paula established the Ad Hoc Committee and appointed Councilmember Victor Farfan and
Councilmember Luis Roa to sit on the committee.

F.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

There were no Oral City Attorney Reports.

G.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Councilmember Roa welcomed the students back at school.

Mayor Pro Tem Del Rio welcomed the students back to the new school year, and thanked everyone who
participated in National Night Out.

Mayor De Paula thanked the school district for dedicated school bus service; attended National Night
Out; and attended the back­to­school concert at the park.
